findings.source_quote: Their enemies called them “Anabaptists” because they rejected infant baptism.
findings.suggested_fix: Use a single consistent, standard Urdu rendering for the term throughout the article (for example: "انابپٹسٹس" or "انی بپٹسٹس") and apply it consistently in every occurrence. Do not change the English name; provide one Urdu transliteration and use it everywhere.
findings.translation_quote: انہوں نے انہیں "انی بپٹسٹس" کہا کیونکہ انہوں نے بچوں کے بپتسمہ کو رد کیا تھا۔
